thread:
maya: Hey folks — PR 48321 opened: split-kv-shard routing + shard-aware cache. This touches runtime routing, platform config, and a tiny KMS call in the cache warmup path. Targeting merge Wed 10:00 PT (canary first). Who can take runtime and infra eyes? @elena can you triage sec implications?

jordan: Link? quick tl;dr of the rollout plan?

maya: https://git.company/repo/pull/48321 — rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~3 hours, feature flag runtime.split_kv_shard_enabled, fallback to legacy when flag=off. No schema migration.

diego: I can take runtime by EOD. Does the change hold KV cache per-shard in-process or across nodes? any p95 regressions?

maya: per-process sharding (same memory, different buckets). Perf bench on staging: p50 tokens 18ms -> 19ms, p95 72ms -> 78ms (small tail bump). Warmup reduced cold miss rate by ~18%.

sam: Platform: will need a config toggle in the console + an autoscale tweak for the canary pool. I can own the console toggle if someone adds the feature flag entry and the README.

li: Infra quick question — does this change eviction ordering? If shards are imbalanced we might see higher memory pressure on some GPUs. Which file touches allocator?

maya: Eviction ordering unchanged; we only change bucket mapping. Patch touches runtime/cache/shard_map.cc and runtime/cache/allocator.cc. No allocator algorithm change. I'll add a note in PR about imbalance mitigation (rebalance job planned).

elena: I will triage the KMS call in the warmup path — need a short threat model and justification for why the call is safe at canary. Also want to know if any new logs contain unhashed keys.

ci-bot: build #48321 — full CI passed ✅

diego: quick review done — left one thread-safety comment on shard_map.cc and a suggestion to add a small unit test for concurrent insert+evict. Could we get a synthetic perf run with shard imbalance to validate tail?

maya: thanks @diego — will add the unit test and run the synthetic imbalance perf. I’ll push an update before EOD.

sam: noted on console toggle. @maya can you add the flag metadata file under infra/config/flags.yaml? I’ll wire UI after that.

li: if you can add a short note in the PR about expected worst-case memory delta and the rebalance cron, infra is fine to sign off conditional on the synthetic imbalance run.

elena: once you add the threat model snippet (2–3 bullets) I’ll do a quick security review. If KMS is used only for non-secret indexing keys and we log hashes only, should be fine.

maya: will add: (1) flags.yaml entry, (2) unit test, (3) synthetic imbalance perf output, (4) 3-bullet threat model + logs note. Updating PR now and will ping when ready for final LGTM. Thanks all :pray:

jordan: cheers — ping me when CI artifacts + perf logs are uploaded, I’ll slot the merge if approvals look good.

maya: will do — aiming for final ping ~3750012400.
